description: Confirm a client's attendance to their session, on behalf of the client (e.g. the client called or messaged the org to confirm). Moves scheduled/pending_confirmation → confirmed and notifies the provider. This is the client-portal confirm flow (event role = client), distinct from the org's own admin confirm in booking_update_status. Idempotent: a session already confirmed returns alreadyConfirmed=true. The org API key owner is recorded as the actor acting on behalf of the client (ADR-004 §6).
name: portal_session_confirm
